name: Volumetric Raycasting
aliases: Direct Volume Rendering via Ray Casting
definition: A ray marching technique for rendering volumetric clouds using 3D texture lookup, detail noise carving, and multi-octave Henyey-Greenstein phase function approximation.
summary: Volumetric Raycasting renders translucent 3D volumes by casting rays through the volume to sample and composite data, avoiding polygonal mesh conversion.
